_comment: FIXTURE, not a live site (OPS-PREREG-IDENTIFIABILITY-GATE-W1). The 2026-08-31 trend-mode trigger A as a population-comparison registry row: a 3.0pp floor on the cross-arm excess delta. v1 emitted SELL on 149 of 28,144 scored rows, a minority share of 0.0053, so its 2m bound is 1.06pp and it can never show a 3.0pp move: scripts/check-population-comparison.mjs must refuse this row as NOT_IDENTIFIABLE when it is declared, binding on v1, the narrower arm. Counts are the ones population_comparison.py's self-test already carries. The v2 share was measured 2026-09-02; at declaration it would have been a planning estimate, and v1 binds either way. Mirrored on the pre-registration surface by trigger-a.identifiability.md.
